missing.why: Riot writers have called Amumu a yordle outside the game, and some players will try him. His Universe biography doesn't say so, so under the Rule he's correctly out; consider naming him in the Rule so the end-screen reveal doesn't feel like a mistake.
The most common wrong answer (she lives with the yordle Norra in Bandle City). The Rule already says she's a cat, so not missing.

disputable.why: Many players think of Fizz as a fish-like sea creature rather than a yordle, but his bio calls him a yordle, so he belongs.
A prehistoric yordle who turns into a giant beast; his bio says yordle, so he belongs, but some players argue he's a 'missing link' creature.

wording.why: The Rule names Yuumi but not Amumu, the other common argument.
wording.suggestion: Champions whose official Universe biography says they are a yordle. Yuumi is a cat; Amumu is a mummy.

aliases.why: Kled's lizard mount; players type the pair's other half. Optional: Skaarl is not herself a yordle, so only add if you want it accepted.

fun.why: Everyone can name Teemo and a couple more in 25 seconds, but almost no one names all 14; Corki, Kled and Vex reward players who know the roster.

champion:Teemo.why: The face of the yordles; most players' first answer.

champion:Veigar.why: The tiny master of evil; strongly yordle-coded.

champion:Heimerdinger.why: The yordle scientist; well known even to new players.

champion:Poppy.why: Yordle with a giant hammer; often named early.

champion:Ziggs.why: Clearly a yordle on sight, mid-popular.

champion:Kennen.why: Yordle ninja; top/mid players think of him readily.

champion:Rumble.why: Yordle in a mech; the mech hides him a little.

champion:Gnar.why: Known yordle but the transformation makes some hesitate.

champion:Fizz.why: Many don't think of him as a yordle first.

champion:Corki.why: Hidden in his plane; often forgotten.

champion:Kled.why: Low play rate and riding Skaarl; forgotten by many.

champion:Vex.why: Newer, niche mid-laner; few remember she's a yordle.

tooClever.why: The 'trick' yordle that players who want to look clever reach for, so it ends up chosen much more than its first-thought rate.

gemCandidates.why: The classic 'oh, of course!' answer: everyone knows Corki but forgets the yordle in the plane.
Unmistakably a yordle once revealed, but rarely named because of Skaarl and his low play rate.
Rarest by recall; satisfying for players who know newer champions, but less of an 'of course' moment.
